articles.title_en: The effects of cash for clunkers on local air quality
articles.title_cn: 旧车换现金计划对当地空气质量的影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of a large car scrappage scheme in Germany on new car purchases and local air quality by combining vehicle registration data with data on local air pollutant emissions. For identification we exploit cross-sectional variation across districts in the number of cars eligible for scrappage. The scheme had substantial effects on car purchases and did not simply reallocate demand across time in the short-term. Nevertheless, about half of all subsidized buyers benefited from windfall gains. The renewal of the car stock improved local air quality suggesting substantial mortality benefits that likely exceed the cost of the policy. While policy take-up is somewhat smaller in urban districts, improvements in air quality and health tend to be larger due to a higher car density.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过将车辆注册数据与当地空气污染物排放数据相结合，研究了德国一项大型汽车报废计划对新购车和当地空气质量的影响。为识别因果效应，我们利用了各地区符合报废条件车辆数量的横截面差异。该计划对汽车购买产生了实质性影响，并未在短期内简单地将需求重新分配。然而，约有一半的受补贴购买者获得了意外收益。汽车存量的更新改善了当地空气质量，表明其带来的死亡风险降低效益可能超过政策成本。尽管城市地区的政策参与率略低，但由于汽车密度较高，空气质量和健康的改善往往更大。

articles.title_en: Social housing and the spread of population: Evidence from twentieth century Ireland
articles.title_cn: 社会住房与人口分布：来自二十世纪爱尔兰的证据
articles.abstract_en: How does housing policy influence the long-run distribution of population? We examine the impact on long-term population dynamics of the world’s first large-scale rural public housing scheme, specifically the case of Ireland’s Labourers Acts. We link detailed data on the location of over 45,000 heavily subsidized cottages for agricultural laborers built 1883–1915 in over 200 districts to decennial Censuses between 1841 and 2002. We examine how the density of this social housing affected subsequent population change and find significant persistence in the effect of this treatment on the population. These findings are from specifications that include other factors plausibly related to future population growth, including initial housing stock, land values and population density, as well as distance to urban centres. A causal interpretation is supported by an assessment of pre-trends, by no effect of cottages authorized but not built and by an IV approach that exploits a 1906 limit on legal costs. We also highlight the role of agglomeration in amplifying the impact of the initial investment. Mediation analysis suggests that schooling was a key factor, with districts receiving more cottages less likely to lose primary schools, thus further influencing population growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 住房政策如何影响人口的长期分布？我们考察了世界上第一个大规模农村公共住房计划对长期人口动态的影响，具体而言是爱尔兰的《劳动者法案》案例。我们将超过45,000套建于1883-1915年间、分布在200多个地区的、为农业劳动者提供大量补贴的 cottage 的详细位置数据，与1841年至2002年间的十年一次人口普查数据进行了链接。我们考察了这种社会住房的密度如何影响随后的人口变化，并发现这种处理对人口的影响存在显著的持续性。这些发现来自包含其他可能与未来人口增长相关的因素的规格，包括初始住房存量、土地价值和人口密度，以及到城市中心的距离。因果解释得到了对前期趋势的评估、对已授权但未建造的 cottage 无影响的发现，以及利用1906年法律成本限制的工具变量方法的支持。我们还强调了集聚在放大初始投资影响中的作用。中介分析表明，学校教育是一个关键因素，获得更多 cottage 的地区更不可能失去小学，从而进一步影响人口增长。

articles.title_en: The geography of mortgage interest deductions
articles.title_cn: 抵押贷款利息扣除的地理分布
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the heterogeneous impact of the US federal mortgage interest deduction (MID) on households’ location and tenure decisions. We develop a spatial general-equilibrium model featuring non-homothetic preferences in which households can choose whether to claim the MID or a standard tax deduction. Repealing the MID decreases homeownership rates more strongly in central areas because owner-occupiers migrate to the countryside. Welfare increases slightly because positive externalities from less congested housing markets and undistorted tenure decisions outweigh productivity losses in central locations. An increase in standard tax deductions, as implemented in 2018 by the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, leads to a similar welfare increase.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国联邦抵押贷款利息扣除（MID）对家庭居住地和产权决策的异质性影响。我们构建了一个具有非位似偏好的空间一般均衡模型，其中家庭可以选择申请MID或标准税收扣除。废除MID会降低中心地区的住房拥有率，因为自住业主会迁移到乡村。福利略有增加，因为住房市场拥挤程度降低和产权决策未被扭曲带来的正外部性超过了中心地区的生产率损失。标准税收扣除的增加，如2018年《减税与就业法案》所实施的，会导致类似的福利增加。

articles.title_en: Housing market and school choice response to school quality information shocks✰
articles.title_cn: 住房市场与学校选择对学校质量信息冲击的反应
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates market response to a nationwide school quality information disclosure regime. Exploiting quasi-exogenous timing of the release of information through the school year, I uncover a number of novel empirical findings. First, investigating the house price margin, the results reveal a strikingly convex hedonic price function: large effects to school quality ratings for homes located near schools serving advantaged students but little impact in poorer neighborhoods. These heterogeneous effects can help reconcile relatively modest overall mean school quality capitalization effects with, for example, the large fees wealthier families typically pay for private schools. Furthermore, the results demonstrate that the impact of credible and low frequency school quality information shocks persists through the medium term. Finally, exploring the impact of the same information intervention on the school choice margin demonstrates that uprated schools serving advantaged students experience dramatic increases in demand from local families, however response for schools serving less advantaged families is more muted.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了全国性学校质量信息披露制度下的市场反应。利用学年内信息发布的准外生时机，我发现了若干新颖的实证结果。首先，考察房价边际，结果显示出一个显著凸性的特征价格函数：对于位于服务优势学生学校附近的住房，学校质量评级的影响较大，而在较贫困社区影响甚微。这些异质性效应有助于调和相对温和的平均学校质量资本化效应与例如富裕家庭通常为私立学校支付高额费用之间的矛盾。此外，结果表明，可信且低频的学校质量信息冲击的影响在中期内持续存在。最后，探讨同一信息干预对学校选择边际的影响表明，服务优势学生的评级上调学校经历了当地家庭需求的急剧增加，然而服务弱势家庭的学校反应则较为温和。

articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether homeowner opposition to nearby housing development affects local councillors’ votes on housing bills. Homeowners benefit financially from restricted housing supply through increased housing prices. City councillors, who approve housing development applications, cater to the needs of homeowners who are often long-term resident voters with a financial stake in neighbourhood amenity levels. Using data from Toronto, Canada from 2009 to 2020, we identify housing bills through a machine learning algorithm. We find that councillors who represent more homeowners oppose more housing bills. In particular, councillors are significantly more likely to oppose large housing developments if the project is within their own ward.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了房主对附近住房开发的反对是否会影响地方议员对住房法案的投票。房主通过限制住房供给导致房价上涨而获得经济利益。市议员负责审批住房开发申请，他们迎合房主的需求，这些房主通常是长期居住的选民，且其经济利益与社区环境质量相关。利用加拿大安大略省多伦多市2009年至2020年的数据，我们通过机器学习算法识别住房法案。我们发现，代表更多房主的议员反对更多住房法案。特别是，如果项目位于议员自己的选区内，议员更有可能反对大型住房开发项目。

articles.abstract_en: This paper provides a theoretical argument for preferential treatment of shared vehicles (SV) over private ones by municipal parking authorities. When all parked vehicles are treated equally, multiple equilibria may exist: (i) a “private” one, in which travellers are hesitant to switch to SV because the latter are hard to find, and (ii) a “shared” equilibrium, in which travellers use shared mobility because the city is saturated with vacant SV. The latter equilibrium, if it exists, is shown to yield higher welfare. Municipal parking discounts for SV reduce the amount of investment required for a “big push” towards the shared equilibrium, or even make it the only equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文为市政停车管理部门对共享车辆（SV）相对于私人车辆给予优惠待遇提供了理论依据。当所有停放车辆被同等对待时，可能存在多重均衡：（i）“私人”均衡，其中出行者因共享车辆难以找到而犹豫是否转向使用；（ii）“共享”均衡，其中出行者因城市中充斥着空闲共享车辆而使用共享出行。后者均衡（若存在）被证明能带来更高的福利。市政对共享车辆的停车折扣减少了实现“大推动”向共享均衡所需投资，甚至可能使其成为唯一均衡。

articles.title_en: Local causes and aggregate implications of land use regulation
articles.title_cn: 土地使用监管的地方成因与总体影响
articles.abstract_en: I study why some cities have strict land use regulation, how regulation affects the U.S. economy, and how policymakers can mitigate its negative consequences. I develop a quantitative spatial equilibrium model where local regulation is determined endogenously, by voting. Landowners in productive cities with attractive amenities vote for strict regulation. The model accounts for 40% of the observed differences in regulation across cities. Quantitative experiments show that excessive local regulation reduces aggregate productivity, but not necessarily welfare because, unlike renters, landowners benefit from regulation. I propose federal policies that raise productivity and welfare by weakening incentives to regulate land use.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究为什么一些城市有严格的土地使用监管，监管如何影响美国经济，以及政策制定者如何减轻其负面后果。我开发了一个定量空间均衡模型，其中地方监管由投票内生决定。具有吸引人便利设施的生产性城市中的土地所有者投票支持严格监管。该模型解释了观察到的城市间监管差异的40%。定量实验表明，过度的地方监管降低了总体生产率，但不一定降低福利，因为与租房者不同，土地所有者从监管中受益。我提出了通过削弱土地使用监管激励来提高生产率和福利的联邦政策。
